Marta: Heads up — since the midnight deploy I'm seeing a ~12% increase in P95 request time for hosted inference on HTTP streaming. Host CPU climbs and tokenization time looks elevated. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/boards/ingress-p95 :eyes:
Dmitri: Ugh. Is this across all regions or just canary? Any recent kernel-selection or batching changes in the last deploy?
Marta: Canary + two NA zones. No kernel selection changes in model runtime, but there was an ingress change that adjusted small-write coalescing and moved the preparse path to the new "slimframe" framer. KV cache miss rate also ticked +7% on those hosts.
Sai: Can you grab a flame/pprof snapshot from a hot host and paste the top few lines? Even a tiny table helps.
Marta: Pasted sample from pprof (cpu, 30s):
```
pprof top
10.2% tokenize::split_tokens
8.7% parse::unpack_stream
7.3% grpc::writev_small
5.1% kvcache::lookup (miss path accounting)
3.5% slab::alloc
```
Marta: Also seeing lots of repeated tokenize calls for partial frames (many small frames hitting tokenization repeatedly).
Dmitri: That matches my suspicion — the slimframe framer reduced memcopy for big frames but increases micro-fragmentation for streaming chunks, which forces host to re-tokenize prefixes instead of using prefix/KV cache.
Eve: So we have two interacting regressions: (1) more small writes -> more tokenization overhead; (2) small-write pattern reduces effective KV prefix reuse -> higher miss rate.
Sai: Quick mitigation ideas: bump ingress read-buffer to reduce app-level fragmentation (e.g., 512 -> 2048), re-enable legacy coalescing for streams, or add a micro-prefetch path in tokenizer to stash partial prefix until frame completes. Which is fastest?
Marta: I ran a short canary with read-buffer=2048 on one host. Preliminary: P95 down ~6% vs affected hosts, kv miss back to baseline. No other regressions in traces.
Dmitri: Good. Also check batching heuristics — if requests are now arriving in smaller chunks, runtime may pick a different kernel (small batch, single-token kernel) causing less efficient GPU utilization. Can you capture kernel selection histogram for the canary window?
Marta: Will capture. Early trace shows more single-frame kernel picks for sequences <8 tokens.
BuildBot: @deploy-bot rolled back ingress-flag slimframe=false on canary (job 2056012399) :white_check_mark:
Eve: Assigning follow-ups: Marta to run 1h A/B with buffer bump; Dmitri to add instrumentation for kernel-selection histograms and KV reuse per request; Sai to prototype micro-prefetch in tokenizer.
Marta: Starting A/B now. Adding note to incident board and will upload the full flamegraph + pprof link when ready. :thumbsup:
Dmitri: If buffer bump is stable we can roll to NA zones and then revert slimframe permanently or tune its coalescing threshold. Also add a regression test that simulates 1-8 token streaming workloads in CI.
Eve: Agreed — add automated microbench in nightly perf job.
Marta: Update (T+10m canary): P95 on canary hosts trending back to baseline, CPU down ~8%. Will leave A/B running for 1h.
Dmitri: Thanks — keep short notes here with attachments (pprof/grafana) so we have a record.
Marta: Will do. End of thread for now.
